text: The report is the basis of the material entries of the equipment register and of the piping material classes (ALP-EPC-00000-PI-SPC-0001), the painting specification (ALP-EPC-00000-ME-SPC-0002) and the cathodic protection design (ALP-EPC-00000-EL-CAL-0005). Materials in vendor proposals shall be reviewed against this report.
